channel.title: GATE Guide — free GATE 2027 guides
channel.description: Free GATE 2027 guides for CSE, ECE, CE, DA, EE and ME: syllabus, weightage, important topics and preparation, by MD ANISH AHAMAD.

item.title: GATE ECE 2027 Preparation Strategy: Ordered by Marks
item.description: A GATE ECE 2027 preparation strategy ordered by what five counted EC papers were actually worth, with twenty-week, eight-week and two-week plans.

item.title: Parsing Questions in GATE CSE: LL(1), SLR, LALR and CLR
item.description: How GATE CSE asks parsing questions. FIRST and FOLLOW rules, LL(1) table conflicts, LR(0) item counting and SLR, LALR and CLR conflicts.

item.title: How to Score 50 in GATE ECE in 3 Months: A 12-Week Plan
item.description: How to score 50 in GATE ECE in 3 months, with the section-by-section arithmetic behind the target and a 12-week plan ordered by five counted EC papers.

item.title: How to Score 50 in GATE ECE in 2 Months, Starting Almost From Zero
item.description: How to score 50 in GATE ECE in 2 months when little is done yet. An 8-week first-pass plan, the honest arithmetic behind 50, and what to leave out.

item.title: How to Score 50 in GATE ECE in 1 Month: A Four-Week Triage Plan
item.description: How to score 50 in GATE ECE in 1 month. A four-week triage plan that shows what to study, what to drop, and the honest arithmetic behind a target of 50.

item.title: How to Score 50+ in GATE CSE in 3 Months: A 12-Week Plan
item.description: How to score 50 in GATE CSE in 3 months. A 12-week plan with a marks budget per subject, what to study each week, six timed mocks and the checks that matter.

item.title: How to Score 50 in GATE CSE in 1 Month: A 4-Week Triage Plan
item.description: How to score 50 in GATE CSE in 1 month if you are starting late. A 4-week triage plan that ranks subjects by marks per hour, what to cut, and three mocks.

item.title: How to Score 50 in GATE CE in 3 Months: A 12-Week Plan
item.description: How to score 50 in GATE CE in 3 months, with the section-by-section arithmetic behind a 50-mark target and a 12-week plan built on sixteen counted papers.

item.title: How to Score 50 in GATE CE in 2 Months, Starting With Little Done
item.description: How to score 50 in GATE CE in 2 months from a standing start, choosing topics by counted marks per hour, with the arithmetic and an 8-week plan.

item.title: How to Score 50 in GATE CE in 1 Month: A 4-Week Triage Plan
item.description: How to score 50 in GATE CE in 1 month, with a four-week triage plan, the topics that carry the marks, and honest arithmetic on what a month can support.

item.title: GATE ECE Last 2 Months Strategy: What to Do in the Final 8 Weeks
item.description: A GATE ECE last 2 months strategy for candidates who have already studied. Revision passes, mock reviews, format drills and a quiet final fortnight.

item.title: GATE CSE Topics for 50 Marks: Which Subjects Add Up and Why
item.description: Which GATE CSE topics add up to about 50 marks, with the arithmetic. Marks per subject from past papers, a realistic hit rate for each, and what to skip.

item.title: GATE CE Last 2 Months Strategy: What to Do in the Final 8 Weeks
item.description: A GATE CE last 2 months strategy for candidates who have studied the syllabus once, with a diagnostic week, revision by counted marks and a mock cadence.

item.title: GATE ECE Important Topics for 2027, Ranked by Marks
item.description: GATE ECE important topics ordered by marks counted from five EC papers rather than by syllabus order, with the concepts that recur and the evidence behind each.

item.title: GATE CE Subject-Wise Weightage: 16 Papers, Both Sets Counted
item.description: GATE CE subject wise weightage counted from all sixteen Civil papers, both sets from 2019 to 2026, with the mean and the range printed for every section.

item.title: GATE ECE 2027 Syllabus Changes: Every Word That Moved
item.description: The GATE ECE 2027 syllabus compared word by word with 2026 from the official PDFs. Twelve phrases added, five removed, and the four that change what you study.

item.title: Context-Free Language Questions in GATE CSE: Method and Traps
item.description: How GATE CSE asks context-free language questions. Classify a language fast, use the closure grid, and answer the decidability lists without guessing.

item.title: GATE ECE Subject-Wise Weightage, Counted from Five Papers
item.description: GATE ECE subject wise weightage counted question by question from five EC papers against the official answer keys, with the full table and the section means.

item.title: Normalization Questions in GATE CSE: Keys, 3NF, BCNF
item.description: How GATE CSE asks functional dependency and normalization questions: attribute closure, counting candidate keys, 2NF to BCNF, and lossless decomposition.

item.title: Finite Automata and Regular Language Questions in GATE CSE
item.description: How GATE CSE asks finite automata questions. Counting minimal DFA states, subset construction, regular expression equivalence and the pumping lemma.
